name: Sneaky Kitten
steps: Tap the trash can to reveal the cockroach.
Drag the cockroach to the shop manager.
Grab the boombox from the shelf.
Place the boombox on the street.
Tap the boombox to play music.
Drag the fallen wooden sign to the vine.
Pick up the necklace from the puddle.
Give the necklace to the manager.
Swipe the sausage from the grill.
Give the sausage to the kitten to complete the level.
